question: Oda-sensei, hello!! Here's my question. Oars might be very big, but is he a giant?? If he IS a giant, does that mean he's from Elbaph? Explain the background, here! Nara
answer: You know how there's always one REALLY BIG guy in your class? Oars is a giant, but he's even huger than normal, among them. He's not a warrior of Elbaph. There are multiple islands around the world with giants living on them. He's just a big huge, evil giant from one of those islands. That's Oars!
name: Nara Nara
